Art

For art, you can tag things individually, and/or you can make a json file in a folder to automatically tag everything in that folder with one or more tags! You can mix and match the methods, however you want. This then automatically makes tagged pages, with a matching alphabeticized tag list on the side.

The consectetur, dolor, and ipsum folders have an example of a folder-wide tag. lorem and sit-amet have examples of manual tags. /consectetur/500-700/ has an example of mix and match.
